title: Contact Us
description: co.uk We’d love to hear from you If you have questions, suggestions or feedback about RabbitCare.co.uk, please get in touch. Your ideas help make the site…
body:
<div class="wp-block-group alignfull">
<!--
RabbitCare.co.uk page block
Page: Contact Us
How to use in WordPress:
1) Edit the Contact Us page.
2) Add a "Custom HTML" block.
3) Replace the old page content with everything below.

Notes:
- No custom header/nav or footer included.
- Internal links use root-relative URLs.
- Uses the same visual style as the RabbitCare homepage and article pages.
-->

<section class="rccnt-page alignfull" id="rabbitcare-contact">
  <style>
    :root {
      --rc-cream: #fff9ef;
      --rc-cream-2: #f6ead8;
      --rc-sage: #7f9b72;
      --rc-sage-dark: #4e6b45;
      --rc-moss: #2f4a2e;
      --rc-gold: #d7a64b;
      --rc-charcoal: #2d2d2b;
      --rc-muted: #6f6a61;
      --rc-danger: #9b3b2f;
      --rc-danger-soft: #fff0eb;
      --rc-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.16);
      --rc-radius-xl: 34px;
      --rc-radius-lg: 24px;
      --rc-max: 1180px;
      --rc-font-heading: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      --rc-font-body: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    .rccnt-page,
    .rccnt-page * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    body,
    .wp-site-blocks,
    .entry-content,
    .wp-block-post-content,
    main {
      background: #fef4f0 !important;
    }

    body .wp-site-blocks,
    body .entry-content,
    body .wp-block-post-content,
    body main,
    body article,
    body .wp-block-group,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      gap: 0 !important;
      row-gap: 0 !important;
    }

    body .entry-header,
    body .page-header,
    body .wp-block-post-title,
    body h1.wp-block-post-title,
    body .wp-block-post-featured-image {
      display: none !important;
    }

    body .wp-site-blocks > * + *,
    body .entry-content > * + *,
    body .wp-block-post-content > * + * {
      margin-block-start: 0 !important;
    }

    body .wp-block-html,
    body .entry-content > .wp-block-html,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      margin-bottom: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      padding-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .rccnt-page {
      position: relative;
      left: calc(50% + 20px);
      width: calc(100vw + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      margin: -120px 0 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.18), transparent 32rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rc-cream) 0%, #fffdf8 46%, #fef4f0 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      line-height: 1.68;
    }

    .rccnt-page a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    .rccnt-page a:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.9);
      outline-offset: 4px;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    .rccnt-wrap {
      width: min(var(--rc-max), calc(100% - 34px));
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .rccnt-narrow {
      width: min(920px, calc(100% - 34px));
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .rccnt-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .rccnt-pill::before {
      content: "✦";
      color: var(--rc-gold);
    }

    .rccnt-btns {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 30px;
    }

    .rccnt-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 900;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rccnt-btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    .rccnt-btn-primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rc-sage-dark), var(--rc-sage));
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(79, 112, 70, 0.26);
    }

    .rccnt-btn-secondary {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rccnt-hero {
      padding: 0 0 42px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.18), transparent 28rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fff9ef 0%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0) 100%);
    }

    .rccnt-hero-image-wrap {
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rccnt-hero-cover {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      margin-top: 0;
    }

    .rccnt-hero-cover::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.70), rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.30) 48%, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.06)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), transparent 45%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.12));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rccnt-hero-image {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
      background: #fff;
      animation: rccntFadeIn 0.9s ease both;
    }

    .rccnt-hero-title-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      left: max(24px, calc((100vw - var(--rc-max)) / 2));
      bottom: clamp(28px, 8vw, 96px);
      max-width: 720px;
      padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 38px);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .rccnt-hero-title-overlay .rccnt-pill {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rccnt-hero-title-overlay h1 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(3.2rem, 8vw, 7.4rem);
      line-height: 0.88;
      letter-spacing: -0.065em;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-wrap: balance;
      text-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
    }

    .rccnt-hero-title-overlay p {
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);
    }

    .rccnt-hero-content {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr;
      gap: 34px;
      align-items: center;
      padding-top: 44px;
    }

    .rccnt-breadcrumb {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rccnt-breadcrumb a {
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
    }

    .rccnt-intro-heading {
      margin: 12px 0 16px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.4rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rccnt-hero-subtitle {
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.28rem);
    }

    .rccnt-contact-card,
    .rccnt-panel,
    .rccnt-card,
    .rccnt-side-card {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rccnt-contact-card {
      padding: 28px;
      border-radius: 38px;
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rccnt-contact-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.45rem;
      line-height: 1.18;
    }

    .rccnt-contact-card p {
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .rccnt-email-box {
      display: grid;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.14);
    }

    .rccnt-email-label {
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .rccnt-email-link {
      color: var(--rc-moss) !important;
      font-weight: 950;
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .rccnt-quickbar {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 4;
      margin-top: 26px;
    }

    .rccnt-quickbar-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rccnt-quick {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      min-height: 96px;
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rccnt-quick:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(83, 61, 42, 0.14);
    }

    .rccnt-quick-icon {
      width: 62px;
      height: 62px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      font-size: 2.35rem;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .rccnt-quick strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      line-height: 1.15;
      font-size: 1.02rem;
    }

    .rccnt-quick span span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .rccnt-section {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 72px 0;
      position: relative;
    }

    .rccnt-section-header {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 0 auto 32px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .rccnt-section h2,
    .rccnt-thanks h2 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.6rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rccnt-section-header p {
      margin: 0 auto;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      max-width: 680px;
    }

    .rccnt-two-col {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 0.85fr;
      gap: 30px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .rccnt-panel {
      position: relative;
      padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 42px);
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rccnt-panel::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 190px;
      height: 190px;
      right: -82px;
      top: -92px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.10);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rccnt-panel > * {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .rccnt-panel p {
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
    }

    .rccnt-panel p:last-child {
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }

    .rccnt-image-card {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 440px;
    }

    .rccnt-image-card img {
      position: absolute;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      border: 10px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      transition: transform 0.35s ease;
    }

    .rccnt-image-card img:hover {
      transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.03) !important;
    }

    .rccnt-img-main {
      width: 82%;
      height: 360px;
      left: 0;
      top: 18px;
      border-radius: 42px;
      transform: rotate(-2deg);
    }

    .rccnt-img-badge {
      width: 48%;
      height: 210px;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      border-radius: 34px;
      transform: rotate(4deg);
      background: #fff9ef;
    }

    .rccnt-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rccnt-card {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rccnt-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15);
    }

    .rccnt-card b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 54px;
      height: 54px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.35rem;
    }

    .rccnt-card h3 {
      margin: 0 0 8px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.18rem;
      line-height: 1.18;
    }

    .rccnt-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
    }

    .rccnt-notice {
      padding: 68px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 240, 235, 0.56), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rccnt-notice-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 44px);
      border-radius: 42px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(155, 59, 47, 0.16);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
    }

    .rccnt-notice-card h2 {
      color: var(--rc-danger);
    }

    .rccnt-notice-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.06rem;
    }

    .rccnt-notice-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rccnt-notice-list li {
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: var(--rc-danger-soft);
      color: #4a2823;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rccnt-notice-list strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-danger);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
    }

    .rccnt-thanks {
      padding: 70px 0 42px;
      background: #fef4f0;
    }

    .rccnt-thanks-box {
      padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 52px);
      border-radius: 46px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(28, 48, 27, 0.92), rgba(58, 84, 49, 0.86)),
        url("/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Rabbitcare-contact.png");
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rccnt-thanks-box .rccnt-pill,
    .rccnt-thanks-box h2,
    .rccnt-thanks-box p {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rccnt-thanks-box p {
      max-width: 760px;
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      font-size: 1.08rem;
    }

    .rccnt-thanks-box .rccnt-btn-secondary {
      background: #ffffff;
      color: #2f4a2e;
      border: 2px solid #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
      text-shadow: none;
    }

    .rccnt-disclaimer {
      padding: 0 0 42px;
      background: #fef4f0;
    }

    .rccnt-disclaimer p {
      max-width: 900px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 18px 20px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      text-align: center;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
    }

    .rccnt-reveal {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(24px);
      animation: rccntFadeUp 0.9s ease forwards;
      animation-timeline: view();
      animation-range: entry 12% cover 30%;
    }

    @keyframes rccntFadeIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.985); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
    }

    @keyframes rccntFadeUp {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(26px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .rccnt-page *,
      .rccnt-page *::before,
      .rccnt-page *::after {
        animation: none !important;
        transition: none !important;
        scroll-behavior: auto !important;
      }

      .rccnt-reveal {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: none;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 980px) {
      .rccnt-page {
        left: 50%;
        width: 100vw;
        margin-top: -90px !important;
        transform: translateX(-50%);
      }

      .rccnt-wrap,
      .rccnt-narrow {
        width: min(100% - 28px, var(--rc-max));
      }

      .rccnt-hero-content,
      .rccnt-two-col,
      .rccnt-notice-card {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .rccnt-quickbar-inner,
      .rccnt-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      }

      .rccnt-image-card {
        min-height: 420px;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .rccnt-page {
        left: 50%;
        width: 100vw;
        max-width: 100vw;
        margin-top: -90px !important;
        transform: translateX(-50%);
        overflow-x: hidden;
      }

      .rccnt-wrap,
      .rccnt-narrow {
        width: calc(100% - 24px);
      }

      .rccnt-hero {
        padding: 0 0 28px;
      }

      .rccnt-hero-title-overlay {
        left: 12px;
        right: 12px;
        bottom: 18px;
        padding: 18px;
      }

      .rccnt-hero-title-overlay h1 {
        font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 15vw, 4.2rem);
        line-height: 0.92;
      }

      .rccnt-hero-title-overlay p {
        font-size: 1rem;
      }

      .rccnt-hero-content {
        padding-top: 30px;
        gap: 22px;
      }

      .rccnt-quickbar-inner,
      .rccnt-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .rccnt-quickbar-inner {
        padding: 12px;
        border-radius: 24px;
      }

      .rccnt-quick {
        grid-template-columns: 54px 1fr;
        min-height: 76px;
        padding: 14px;
        border-radius: 18px;
      }

      .rccnt-quick-icon {
        width: 54px;
        height: 54px;
        font-size: 2.1rem;
      }

      .rccnt-section,
      .rccnt-notice {
        padding: 46px 0;
      }

      .rccnt-section h2,
      .rccnt-thanks h2,
      .rccnt-intro-heading {
        font-size: clamp(2rem, 11vw, 3rem);
        line-height: 1.02;
        letter-spacing: -0.045em;
      }

      .rccnt-contact-card,
      .rccnt-panel {
        padding: 22px;
        border-radius: 26px;
      }

      .rccnt-image-card {
        min-height: 0;
        display: grid;
        gap: 12px;
      }

      .rccnt-img-main,
      .rccnt-img-badge,
      .rccnt-image-card img {
        position: static;
        width: 100%;
        height: 230px;
        left: auto;
        right: auto;
        top: auto;
        bottom: auto;
        transform: none !important;
        border-radius: 24px;
        border-width: 6px;
      }

      .rccnt-notice-card {
        padding: 22px;
        border-radius: 28px;
      }

      .rccnt-btns {
        gap: 10px;
      }

      .rccnt-btn {
        width: 100%;
        min-height: 48px;
        padding: 12px 14px;
        text-align: center;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
      }

      .rccnt-thanks {
        padding-top: 46px;
      }

      .rccnt-thanks-box {
        padding: 24px;
        border-radius: 30px;
      }
    }


    .rccnt-faq {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.08), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rccnt-faq-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }

    .rccnt-faq-item {
      border-radius: 26px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.14);
      box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rccnt-faq-item summary {
      cursor: pointer;
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 20px 22px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      font-weight: 900;
    }
